answer: Make new identities pass through a slow jetty: each fresh agent must post a small bond that unlocks only after it has been graded by randomly drawn established peers over several epochs. A sybil farm then pays the bond per clone and waits, while graders watch like a raven for near-duplicate answers across accounts. Clusters with quartz-identical timing or wording forfeit their bonds, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes and yields almost nothing.
